provenance: Fixed before any output from the new local 1B/4B checkpoints was examined. Regression cases are not held-out. New means not present in the existing production examples or prior project evaluation inputs; it does not establish absence from model training data.
normalization: NFC Unicode, whitespace collapse, punctuation treated as word boundaries only. Case, accents, Arabic letters, numbers, and transliteration are not normalized.
